MYSTS2MOD-SPARK.title: Spark
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_STRIKE.title: Hao Strike
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage. Deals 1 additional damage per Hao.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_DEFEND.title: Hao Defend
MYSTS2MOD-HAO_DEFEND.description:
Gain Block equal to triple your Hao, up to {BlockCap:diff()}.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-NARCISSISM.title: Narcissism
MYSTS2MOD-FIGURE_SHADOW.title: Figure Shadow
MYSTS2MOD-DEBUGGING.title: Debugging
MYSTS2MOD-DEBUGGING.description:
If you have more than 10 Hao, reduce it to 10 and gain Block equal to twice the amount removed.{InCombat:
(Gain {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_OFFENSE.title: Code Offense
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_OFFENSE.description:
Deal 2 damage per Hao. If you have at least {HaoCap:diff()} Hao, deal 1.5 times that damage.{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
MYSTS2MOD-KICK_UP.title: Kick Up
MYSTS2MOD-KICK_UP.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain 3 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-EXAM.title: Exam
MYSTS2MOD-EXAM.description: If you have less than 10 Hao, double your Hao. Otherwise, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
MYSTS2MOD-CALM.title: Calm
MYSTS2MOD-CALM.description:
Lose all Hao. Deal damage equal to 3 times the amount lost and gain that much Block.{InCombat:
(Deal {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedDamage:diff()}|0} damage, gain {HasHaoToLose:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} Block)|}
MYSTS2MOD-CONFLICT.title: Conflict
MYSTS2MOD-CONFLICT.description: Apply {Vulnerable:diff()} Vulnerable. If you have at least 10 Hao, additionally deal {Damage:diff()} damage and lose 5 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-FIRE_IN_SOUL.title: Fire in Soul
MYSTS2MOD-FIRE_IN_SOUL.description: Apply {Frail} Frail to yourself. Draw {Cards:diff()} card(s) and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.title: Surfing
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.description: Choose a card from your discard pile and put it on top of your draw pile. Lose {HaoCost} Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-SURFING.selectPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your draw pile.
MYSTS2MOD-STUDENT_LEADER.title: Student Leader
MYSTS2MOD-STUDENT_LEADER.description: Lose all Hao. Gain 1 Dexterity for every 4 Hao lost.
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT.title: Shanghai Student
MYSTS2MOD-SHANG_HAI_STUDENT.description: This turn, every card you play grants 1 Hao and {BlockEach:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER.title: Sneer
MYSTS2MOD-SNEER.description:
Apply {Vulnerable} Vulnerable to yourself. This turn, when you block damage from an enemy, deal damage equal to the amount blocked back to that enemy.{IfUpgraded:show: 
Gain {Block:diff()} Block next turn.|}
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680.title: Equal 680
MYSTS2MOD-EQUAL680.description: While your Max HP is lower than the target enemy's, you deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage.
MYSTS2MOD-GROUP_DISCUSS.title: Group Discussion
MYSTS2MOD-GROUP_DISCUSS.description: If the target intends to Attack, gain 1 Intangible. Otherwise, deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT.title: Unrepentant
MYSTS2MOD-UNREPENTANT.description: Until the start of your next turn, unblocked damage is converted into an equal amount of Hao. Next turn, whenever you play a card, take 3 damage.
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS.title: Genius?
MYSTS2MOD-GENIUS.description: At the start of your turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} and draw {Draw:diff()} cards. After you lose Hao, the current or next damage you receive from an enemy is doubled.
MYSTS2MOD-GRAMMAR.title: Grammar
MYSTS2MOD-GRAMMAR.description: Add a random upgraded Skill card to your hand; it costs 0 this turn. If you have at least {HaoThreshold:diff()} Hao, it costs 0 for the rest of this combat instead.
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO.title: Magnificent Hao
MYSTS2MOD-MAGNIFICENT_HAO.description: Gain 1 Hao. This turn, gain 1 additional Hao for every 2 cards drawn. Next turn, draw 1 card and draw 1 additional card for every 2 times you gain Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE.title: Math Prince
MYSTS2MOD-MATH_PRINCE.description: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Strength for every 4 Hao you have. Lose that Strength at the end of your turn.
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_CODE_CODE.title: Code Code Code
MYSTS2MOD-CODE_CODE_CODE.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Whenever you lose Hao, return this card from your discard pile to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD.title: Super Hao Field
MYSTS2MOD-SUPER_HAO_FIELD.description: At the end of your turn, gain Block equal to half your Hao (rounded down) and deal that much damage to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM.title: Tsinghua Form
MYSTS2MOD-TSINGHUA_FORM.description: Whenever you lose Hao, regain half the amount lost (rounded down) and gain that much Block.
MYSTS2MOD-INFINITE_HAO.title: Infinite Hao
MYSTS2MOD-INFINITE_HAO.description: Deal damage equal to your Hao X{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]+1[/gold]|} times, then lose 6 Hao. Repeat this effect until you have less than 6 Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-BETTER_THAN_WALKER.title: Better Than Walker
MYSTS2MOD-BETTER_THAN_WALKER.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Then kill enemies whose HP is not higher than your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT.title: Final Commit
MYSTS2MOD-FINAL_COMMIT.description: Lose all Block. You cannot gain Block this turn. Immediately triple your Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-HINDSIGHT.title: Hindsight
MYSTS2MOD-HINDSIGHT.description: Lose {HaoCost} Hao. Gain {Block:diff()} Block next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-NEW_GROUP_CHAT.title: New Group Chat
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO.title: Xiao
MYSTS2MOD-XIAO.description: Gain {Hao:diff()} Hao and {Block:diff()} Block. Next turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Chuan+|Chuan} to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN.title: Chuan
MYSTS2MOD-CHUAN.description: Lose {HaoCost} Hao. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Lose {HpLoss} HP. Next turn, add a {IfUpgraded:show:Xiao+|Xiao} to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY.title: Unspoken Fury
MYSTS2MOD-UNSPOKEN_FURY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If you take unblocked damage between the start of this turn and the start of your next turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies again at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-GOD_LIST.title: The “God” List
MYSTS2MOD-GOD_LIST.description: Whenever you gain Hao, gain {GodListPower:diff()} additional Hao. At the end of combat, gain Max HP equal to half your Hao (up to {MaxHpCap}).
MYSTS2MOD-APPEAR.title: Appear
MYSTS2MOD-APPEAR.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter Hao Mode.
MYSTS2MOD-QUANTUM_MECHANICS.title: Quantum Mechanics
MYSTS2MOD-QUANTUM_MECHANICS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-SHI_NONG.title: Shi Nong
MYSTS2MOD-SHI_NONG.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If you are in Hao Mode, apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak.
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.title: Derivation?
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. If you are in the Hidden State, draw {Cards:diff()} card. Choose a card in your Hand to Retain this turn.
MYSTS2MOD-FENCE_SITTER.title: Fence Sitter
MYSTS2MOD-FENCE_SITTER.description: Switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none). Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.title: Planning
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Put a card from your Hand on top of your Draw Pile. If you are in the Hidden State, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-FOOLED_YOU.title: Fooled You
MYSTS2MOD-FOOLED_YOU.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times. Then enter Hao Mode.
MYSTS2MOD-DEPRESSION.title: Depression
MYSTS2MOD-DEPRESSION.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Then enter the Hidden State.
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE.title: Double Life
MYSTS2MOD-DUAL_LIFE.description: The first time each turn you switch between Hidden State and Hao Mode, draw {DualLifePower:diff()} card.
MYSTS2MOD-PLAYING_MYSELF.title: Playing Myself
MYSTS2MOD-PLAYING_MYSELF.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hidden State: gain {Block:diff()} Block. Hao Mode: deal the damage twice instead.
MYSTS2MOD-UNCERTAINTY_PRINCIPLE.title: Uncertainty Principle
MYSTS2MOD-UNCERTAINTY_PRINCIPLE.descript: Exhaust a card from your Hand. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Then switch to the other state (enter Hidden State if you have none).
MYSTS2MOD-PRESS_FORWARD.title: Press Forward
MYSTS2MOD-PRESS_FORWARD.description: Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. If your previous card this turn was a Skill, this value includes {ExtraDamage:diff()} bonus damage.
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM.title: Rhythm
MYSTS2MOD-RHYTHM.description: During a turn, whenever you gain or lose Hao, gain {RhythmPower:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-COMPILER_WARNING.title: Compiler Warning
MYSTS2MOD-DEADLINE_SPRINT.title: Deadline Sprint
MYSTS2MOD-DEADLINE_SPRINT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to yourself.
MYSTS2MOD-KEYBOARD_WARRIOR.title: Keyboard Warrior
MYSTS2MOD-CHAT_HISTORY.title: Chat History
MYSTS2MOD-CHAT_HISTORY.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. Add 1 Chuan to your hand.
MYSTS2MOD-DERIVATION.selectionScreenProm: Choose {Amount} card in your Hand to Retain this turn.
MYSTS2MOD-PLANNING.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose {Amount} card in your Hand to put on top of your Draw Pile.
MYSTS2MOD-STRIKE.title: Strike
MYSTS2MOD-DEFEND.title: Defend
MYSTS2MOD-SUDDEN_REPENTANCE.title: Sudden Repentance
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK.title: Comeback
MYSTS2MOD-COMEBACK.description: At the end of this turn, if you are in Hidden State, Retain all Attack cards and enter Hao Mode at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE.title: Time Waits for No One
MYSTS2MOD-TIME_WAITS_FOR_NO_ONE.descript: While in Hidden State, Attack cards in your Hand Retain. While in Hao Mode, Skill cards in your Hand Retain.
MYSTS2MOD-TIT_FOR_TAT.title: Tit for Tat
MYSTS2MOD-TIT_FOR_TAT.description: Remove all Block from the target and deal that much damage. If the target has no Block, apply {Vulnerable} Vulnerable and {Weak} Weak instead.
MYSTS2MOD-BIAS.title: Bias
MYSTS2MOD-SPEECH.title: Speech
MYSTS2MOD-LOST.title: Lost
MYSTS2MOD-LOST.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block and {Hao:diff()} Hao. If your current HP is below one third of your Max HP, heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
MYSTS2MOD-CROSS_DRESSING.title: Cross-Dressing
MYSTS2MOD-CROSS_DRESSING.description: Exhaust a card in your Hand. If it is an Attack, gain {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity this turn.
MYSTS2MOD-RABBIT_HEAD.title: Rabbit Head
MYSTS2MOD-RABBIT_HEAD.description: Return up to {Cards:diff()} cards from your Discard Pile to your Hand, then Exhaust that many cards from your Hand.
MYSTS2MOD-FIERCER_SMURFING.title: Fiercer Smurfing
MYSTS2MOD-FIERCER_SMURFING.description: At the end of combat, if your HP is at least as high as at the start of combat and you have at least {HaoThreshold:diff()} Hao, you may choose a card in your Deck to Upgrade.
MYSTS2MOD-SMURFING.title: Smurfing
MYSTS2MOD-SMURFING.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Deal double damage if your current HP is higher than the target's current HP.
MYSTS2MOD-ENDLESSSSS.title: Endlesssss
MYSTS2MOD-ENDLESSSSS.description: At the end of this turn, if you played more than {PlayThreshold} cards this turn, draw {Cards:diff()} cards at the start of your next turn.
MYSTS2MOD-TRIATHLON.title: Triathlon
MYSTS2MOD-TRIATHLON.description: After playing this card, play an Attack, a Skill, and a Power this turn to gain {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength and {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity.
MYSTS2MOD-ANSWER_QUESTIONS.title: Answer Questions
MYSTS2MOD-ANSWER_QUESTIONS.description:
Automatically play this card when drawn.
At the end of this turn, double your Hao if you dealt at least {DamageThreshold:diff()} damage to enemies this turn. Otherwise, lose all Hao and take that much damage.
MYSTS2MOD-ONLY_NUMBERS.title: Only Numbers
MYSTS2MOD-M_M_MATH.title: MMMath
MYSTS2MOD-M_M_MATH.description: Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. Gain {Hao:diff()} Hao.
MYSTS2MOD-GERMAN_BOOK.title: German Book
MYSTS2MOD-GERMAN_BOOK.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to yourself and ALL enemies. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-NOTHING_TO_MENTION.title: Nothing to Mention
MYSTS2MOD-NOTHING_TO_MENTION.description: Deal {SelfDamage:diff()} damage to yourself. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
MYSTS2MOD-J_T83.title: JT8-3
MYSTS2MOD-J_T83.description: At the start of your turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. At the end of combat, lose HP equal to your current turn number.
MYSTS2MOD-HOW_TO_CHUAN.title: How to Chuan?
MYSTS2MOD-HOW_TO_CHUAN.description: Add X Chuan{IfUpgraded:show:+|} to your Hand.
MYSTS2MOD-XU_XIAOYAN.title: Xu Xiaoyan
MYSTS2MOD-XU_XIAOYAN.description: At the start of your next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
MYSTS2MOD-INVERSE_MAPPING.title: Inverse Mapping
MYSTS2MOD-INVERSE_MAPPING.description:
Deal damage equal to your current Block{InCombat:
(Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}.
MYSTS2MOD-HANG_SOUTHEAST.title: Hang Southeast
MYSTS2MOD-HANG_SOUTHEAST.description: Play all Powers in your Hand. Exhaust your Hand. Lose all Block.
MYSTS2MOD-RABBIT_HEAD.selectionScreenPro: Return up to {Amount} cards from your Discard Pile to your Hand.
MYSTS2MOD-NOOB.title: Noob
MYSTS2MOD-NOOB.description: Apply {WeakPower:diff()} Weak to yourself. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MYSTS2MOD-BROKEN_DEFENSE.title: Broken Defense
MYSTS2MOD-BROKEN_DEFENSE.description: Apply {FrailPower:diff()} Frail to yourself. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
MYSTS2MOD-ENLIGHTENED.title: Enlightened
MYSTS2MOD-ENLIGHTENED.description: Apply {FrailPower:diff()} Frail to yourself. Choose and Upgrade a card in your Hand.{IfUpgraded:show: It gains Retain for this combat.|}
MYSTS2MOD-TILTED.title: Tilted
MYSTS2MOD-TILTED.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Hit 1 additional time for each kind of Regular Debuff on you.
MYSTS2MOD-UNORTHODOX.title: Unorthodox
MYSTS2MOD-UNORTHODOX.description: Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. If you have at least {DebuffKinds} kinds of Regular Debuff, choose a card in your Draw Pile and add it to your Hand.
MYSTS2MOD-EVEN_WORSE.title: Even Worse
MYSTS2MOD-EVEN_WORSE.description: Apply {FrailPower:diff()} Frail, {WeakPower:diff()} Weak, and {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable to yourself. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
MYSTS2MOD-LET_IT_GO.title: Let It Go
MYSTS2MOD-LET_IT_GO.description: Remove all Regular Debuffs from yourself. Heal {Heal:diff()} HP for each kind removed (up to 6 HP).
MYSTS2MOD-NO_ESCAPE.title: No Escape
MYSTS2MOD-NO_ESCAPE.description: Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable and {FrailPower:diff()} Frail to yourself. At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} extra card.
MYSTS2MOD-SILVER_LINING.title: Silver Lining
MYSTS2MOD-SILVER_LINING.description: During your turn, whenever you play a card that applies a Regular Debuff to yourself, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Triggers up to {TriggerLimit:diff()} times per turn.
MYSTS2MOD-FULL_SURRENDER.title: Full Surrender
MYSTS2MOD-FULL_SURRENDER.description: Apply {FrailPower:diff()} Frail, {WeakPower:diff()} Weak, and {VulnerablePower:diff()} Vulnerable to yourself. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards. Reduce the energy cost of cards in your Hand by {CostReduction} this turn, to a minimum of 0.
MYSTS2MOD-AM_I_SHI_NONG.title: Am I Shi Nong?
MYSTS2MOD-AM_I_SHI_NONG.description: For each stack of Regular Debuff on you, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} Strength and {DexterityPower:diff()} Dexterity this turn, up to {StatCap} Strength and {StatCap} Dexterity.
MYSTS2MOD-UNORTHODOX.selectionScreenProm: Choose a card in your Draw Pile to add to your Hand.
